draftLaw: P18 judgment lane (the gap-profile pool set: 21 pools admitted by owner order "run P18 judgment" 2026-11-20; 5,843 pool uploads dispositioned exactly-once): Tier B course anchors by machine-checkable session/paper codes (method paper-code, confidence high; the P15/P17 registers plus the P18 additions: 4PM0/4PM1 Edexcel IGCSE Further Pure, 8021 General Paper, CIE A-level sciences 9700/9701/9702 paper-number routing papers 1-3 AS / 4-5 A2, 0580 papers 2/4 extended vs 1/3 core per the P9/P14 law with the generalized spine-code precedence over O-Level branding, the International-GCSE-ICT register text) + the P16 Class W set-text predicate for 0475 titles (the disclosed P18 suffix-collision ledger) + Tier A spec rows by the distinctive-token binding rule (df<=3) under the P13/P15 gate ladder: section-marker narrowing, section-name binding (verbatim pipe/dash field equality, node norm >= 8 chars, SUBTOPIC preferred), the four-gate topic-lecture class. Guidance/promo/tuition registers, meta announcements (grade thresholds/timetables/results), the digital-literacy certification register (IC3/Certiport/MOS), CIE AS/A Level IT 9626, the O-Level register (the disclosed 4037/2281/7707/5090 duals exempt, the P14 spine-code precedence generalized), the IAL/CIE maths 9709 bare-walkthrough class (ANCHOR-GRANULARITY section 6, P9 precedent) and out-of-spine boards (AQA/OCR/IB) are excluded and ledgered as skips. Rejected/unrouted videos stay out of videos[]. P18 disclosed regex amendments: the P14..P17 guidance pattern's bare 'vision' token (a substring match inside 'revision') is word-bounded — the P17 skips ledger carries the same latent effect (disclosed, not re-opened); RE_4IT0 gains the International-GCSE-ICT register text.
